card.title: Interpret the Custom
card.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I leave for my shift, how much lasagne will you save me? Family custom says 'a proper portion.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll find out what 'proper' means when it's for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save mine before you serve those. I'd like being expected home to count before being hungry twice.

mechanism: A uses an undefined family food portion to test whether B's allocation treats A as someone expected home.
confusable: Unlike arguing about quantity alone, A makes interpretation of the custom a loyalty decision.
comparison: A late shift competes with brothers' seconds; the club appeal tests whether support extends to a risky signature.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
